caption: The drawing depicts five distinct objects commonly associated with decorative hardware, rendered in shades of gold and brass with dark outlines. At the top center, there is an ornate, symmetrical escutcheon (keyhole cover plate) with curved, scalloped detailing and a central keyhole. Below it, there is a larger, similarly styled handle plate with intricate edges and a central handle in a wide U-shape, attached at both ends by round fasteners. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller, simple ring handle, attached to a circular base. To the right of the smaller handle, there is a small, vertically oriented drop handle and a matching escutcheon plate shown from the side, displaying its profile. At the bottom left is a small scale labeled "INCHES" with a grid for measurement. The drawing is framed with a double-line border and is signed “HANS KORSCH” in the bottom right corner. The overall composition is centered, and all objects are colored in a golden-yellow hue with shading for a metallic effect. The background is an uncolored, off-white paper.
title: Drawer Pull
